value.hook: A university in Korea needed a store room off a teaching building to hold more, without a contractor and without touching the building. The room had to keep working while it was fitted out, on a floor where drilling was not an option. So the frame goes together by hand. HANDiLOCK joints lock the uprights to the beams with no bolts and no tools, which means no drilling, no noise and nothing to lose on the floor. Tier heights move afterwards, in 1.18 inch steps, as what the room holds changes. Homedant USA Inc has been making steel shelving in its own Korean factory since 1979. Rooms like this one are where it ends up. Send me the room dimensions and what has to go in it, and I will come back with a layout and a quote. — Leo Lee What is the longest you have waited on a fit-out that should have taken an afternoon? 해시태그 #Education 해시태그 #InstitutionalStorage 해시태그 #HOMEDANT 해시태그 #SteelShelving 해시태그 #StorageSolutions 해시태그 #KoreanMade 해시태그 #B2B

value.hook: How can hotels and residential projects provide more storage without making rooms feel crowded? Homedant USA Inc’s open wardrobe system is designed to make efficient use of vertical space while providing practical storage for clothing, luggage, and everyday belongings. With its durable steel construction and flexible open design, it can be integrated into: • Hotels and serviced apartments • Condominiums and multifamily residences • Student housing and co-living spaces • Furnished rental properties Manufactured in Korea, HOMEDANT provides project-ready storage solutions for developers, operators, designers, and procurement partners.
